Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

do {
    _ = try Xberg.ocrBackendSupportsLanguage(backend: "nonexistent-backend-xyz", language: "eng")
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
